source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "critical infrastructure" AND (cyber OR cyberattack OR "cyber attack") AND (city OR urban OR resilience)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"critical infrastructure" AND (cyber OR cyberattack OR "cyber attack") AND (city OR urban OR resilience),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("critical infrastructure" AND ("cyber attack" OR "cyber" OR "cyberattack") AND ("city" OR "resilience" OR "urban"))
